R1.description: A pure evaluation of the adopted thresholds against the retention report: per threshold within, reached or unknown with the number and the limit; at or above the limit is reached; the folder limit is MiB compared as bytes with integer arithmetic; an incomplete report gives lower bounds (at or above is reached, below is unknown); an omitted threshold is not checked; nothing but an adopted policy with mode notify or both alerts

R2.description: verify and doctor print a retention alert block (reached and unknown thresholds, the user-only archive or prune step by cause, never run) only for an adopted notify or both policy with a reached threshold; every other case is byte-identical to 1.15.0 and starts no script; doctor --retention runs the script once

R3.description: An unavailable or incomplete retention query prints one not-evaluated line with its cause and step, never an all-clear and never a reached threshold; each failure path leaves the target unchanged

R4.description: The alert changes no exit code and never makes verify fail; it runs only the report command of the retention script, once; the pages document it with its cost

R5.description: The four follow-ups of #192: the adopt-retention-policy help names the link and non-regular-file refusals; the invalid state's next step names the command; adopted_at is parsed with strptime after the shape check; the record's parent directory is fsynced after the atomic replace without masking a successful write

R6.description: Bookkeeping and release: roadmap row 37, the milestone record, a feat pull request title for a minor Manager release
